:::: {#exr-manual target="manual" course-role="independent-study" difficulty="introductory"}
## Explain the result

Explain $x^2 + 1$ and use the [attached data](data.txt).
The [course reference](https://example.org/course) is an ordinary external URL.

![Authored diagram](diagram.svg)

```{r}
#| echo: false
write("executed", file=".course-owner/engine-count", append=TRUE)
plot(1:3, c(1, 4, 9), type="b", xlab="Input", ylab="Result")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
cat("COMPUTED_BODY_CONDITION 42.\n\n")
cat("| Computed input | Computed result |\n|---|---|\n| 6 | 42 |\n\n")
```

::: {.grading-notes}
GRADING_SECRET: require an explanation, not only the number.
:::
::::

::: {#sol-manual .when-full}
TEACHER_SECRET: square the input and add one.
:::

::: {#exr-numeric target="manual" course-role="independent-study" difficulty="introductory"}
## Compute a value

Give the numeric result.

```{.yaml .answer-spec}
type: numeric
key: {value: 12.5, tolerance: {absolute: 0.1}}
```
:::

::: {#exr-multipart target="manual" course-role="independent-study" difficulty="introductory"}
## Give cost and explanation

Supply both requested parts.

```{.yaml .answer-spec}
type: multipart
parts:
  - {name: cost, label: Cost, type: numeric, key: {value: 12.5, tolerance: {absolute: 0.1}}}
  - {name: explanation, label: Explanation, type: manual, submission: text}
```
:::

::: {#exr-matching target="manual" course-role="independent-study" difficulty="introductory"}
## Match each prompt

Associate each prompt with an option.

```{.yaml .answer-spec}
type: matching
prompts: [Process, Thread]
options: [Own space, Shared space, Distractor]
key: {pairs: {Process: Own space, Thread: Shared space}}
```
:::
